slideDifferences.nativeText:
Lemons in life!

If people are thinking that all good things will just land on their lap, they’d better start working on how they can get them. Life is not easy and we should learn how to cope with it intelligently so we get the most of it. You cannot always hit the nose on the head; there are times when you really feel lost or powerless. Nevertheless, hard situations make us grow and strengthen us to face challenges on daily basis. I truly think, we can take the most out of every situation if we really are looking forward to doing it. It intrigues me not to have everything set and at the same time it kind of scares me; however, There will always be something to do for solving any issue we may face.
C. Read the following paragraph and extract sentences that present the language and functions studied.
slideDifferences.publishedText: Successful Managers Know That Luck Goes With Effort Experienced managers learn that success is a combination of luck and effort. Arrogant and inexperienced managers may think any success is entirely from effort. They’d better change that idea. Anyone who works in management long enough will see many managers rise and fall according to their measures of luck and effort. Some of the managers who fall end up rising again through ambition and perseverance while others do not. Firings, demotions, layoffs and personal problems derail many careers. The ones who bounce back, lick their wounds and find a way to rise once more so they can superpass whatever makes them fall. The most successful managers have exceptional traits including higher than average intelligence, character, ambition, energy and leadership skills. But luck does play a part. Even they can’t control everything or guarantee success in any and all situations; shouldn’t this be something to think of? For example, a senior manager who took over a struggling operation couldn’t do anything about a key subordinate who sadly was dying of leukemia. Nor could he do anything about other underperforming business units that were dragging down the entire division, which ultimately led to its demise. Article retrieved and adapted from: https://medium.com/leading-and-managing/successful-managers-know-that-luck-goes-with-effort-d4cf6bc439a2 https://medium.com/leading-and-managing/successful-managers-know-that-luck-goes-with-effort-d4cf6bc439a2 C.
